messages:
zack: seeing p95 jump on decode path on canary after the merge (commit 8f3a2c4) last night. p95 from ~120ms -> ~420ms on short chats. anyone else?
eva: saw the same in CI perf run, throughput looks stable but tail is up. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/r/abc123/attn-p95-spike :grimacing:
mara: bisect points to 8f3a2c4 — kernel selector refactor. i can repro locally with a small-batch workload.
  repro cmd:
  ```bash
  RUNTIME_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=64 SEQ_LEN=16 ./bin/perf_runner --model redwood-v1 --workload small_chat
  ```
  sample perf log:
  ```
  INFO decode: p50=18ms p95=430ms p99=780ms
  nvprof: attn_kernel_dispatch memcpy=32% kernelswitch=18%
  ```
alice: profiler shows hot path flips to the 'attn_scalar' fallback with expensive device->host memcpy in the refactored selector. nvprof flame looks like memcpy and small-kernel overhead dominating.
ben: also noticing kv-cache hit-rate drop around the same window — hit% went from ~92% to ~68% on the canary traces. possible cache thrash from batch reshaping?
mara: root cause hypothesis: new selector computes a "latency_score" using mean(seq_len) and prefers fused kernels when score<threshold. mean is skewed by a few long sequences so short-chats get routed to fallback. old logic used 95th pct. so short sequences lost the fused path.
eva: i pushed a quick hotfix PR that changes the selector to use p95 instead of mean: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321
zack: can we roll that to canary? i'd like to avoid a full revert if hotfix fixes it. requesting canary rollout for PR #4321 and holding revert until we see results.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: rollback queued? No, canary deploy of pr/4321 scheduled to cluster 'canary-east' in 5m. (job id: deploy-2026-03-18-77)
alice: ran microbench after applying p95 fix locally:
  ```
  before: p95=418ms
  after:  p95=126ms
  kv hit: before=69% after=91%
  ```
mara: if PR passes canary let's promote. also adding unit test & perf-smoke for small-batch short-seq to CI to catch regressions.
ben: filing CI perf test issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/987 — proposing perf-suite job with seq_len=8/16 and small-batch config.
zack: assigning @mara and @alice to own the canary validation. i'll hold the revert for 2 hours unless canary p95 stays high. thanks everyone.
mara: :thumbsup: i'll open the hotfix branch, run canary metrics, and post results in this thread.
